$comment: TEST FIXTURES ONLY. Plan names, limits, attachment sizes and prices are illustrative (spec v3.0 section 24) and NOT approved (D09, DEC-040). Prices use ISO 4217 code XTS, reserved for testing, so they can never be charged. Do not publish, display as real prices or seed into production.

quotaKeys.active_seats: Active human memberships including owners; deactivated users and pending invitations do not count (ENT-003)
quotaKeys.attachment_bytes: Stored attachment bytes plus open upload reservations

plans.notes: General goods, stock workflows, basic reports. attachment_bytes (1 GiB) is a test value.
General core plus service API access and expanded reporting. attachment_bytes (5 GiB) is a test value.
Growth plus medical workflows and telemetry. Activating medical_storage also requires medical readiness (R1B gates, M5). attachment_bytes (50 GiB) is a test value.

rules.neverForSale: No plan can disable medical safety controls or tenant security (section 24).
rules.safetyIgnoresEntitlements: Operations in access category 'safety' are never refused for a missing feature (ENT-006, docs/saas-state-matrix.md).
rules.atQuota: Reads, edits and stock operations on existing records continue; only creations of the constrained resource fail with 409 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED (ENT-004).
rules.upgrade: Effective from the next full billing cycle after verified payment; no proration in R1 (ENT-005).
rules.downgrade: Scheduled for renewal only when usage fits; blocked while medical/telemetry obligations remain (ENT-006).
